name: multi-file-audit
description: Audit tool files for consistent security patterns and produce a report. Multi-file analysis task.
task: Security review: are all the tools in Sources/Yrden/Tools/ properly validating file paths before accessing the filesystem? Check each tool that takes a path parameter and see if it calls pathValidator.validateRead or pathValidator.validateWrite before using that path. Write your findings to audit.md — for each tool, say whether it validates and which methods it uses.
